text: 【地产股持续大涨 业内人士：全国性政策的可能性不大】A股房地产板块持续沸腾，多只个股涨停。市场兴奋的背后，除了地产股整体估值偏低之外，关于全国性贴息政策的传闻也成为重要助力。多个券商房地产行业分析师认为全国性贴息政策落地的可能性不大，有分析师表示，“国家层面上，延长贷款期限其实和贴息/降息减少的利息差不多”。
text_en: [Real estate stocks continue sharp rally; industry insiders: nationwide policy unlikely] A-share real estate sector continues to boil, with multiple stocks hitting the daily limit. Behind the market excitement, besides the sector's overall low valuations, rumors of a nationwide interest subsidy policy have also become an important driver. Real estate industry analysts at multiple brokerages believe the likelihood of a nationwide interest subsidy policy being implemented is low. One analyst said, "At the national level, extending loan terms is actually similar to the interest reduced by interest subsidies/rate cuts."
